name: Sung Jung
headline: Business Systems | Operations Systems | Process Improvement
summary: Operations and QA professional translating warehouse and software workflows into practical system improvements. Experience in operational requirements, workflow analysis, stakeholder coordination, data validation, and release testing. Uses AI-assisted development and automation to reduce repetitive work while retaining human review and exception handling.
competencies: Workflow analysis | Operational requirements | Process improvement | Stakeholder coordination | Work instructions | Data validation | Exception management | Defect reproduction | Regression testing | Fix verification

roles.title: Senior Operations Manager
bullets: Helped establish account-specific locations, picking and packing workflows, and work instructions across Extensiv WMS and Workpad OMS for a warehouse receiving approximately 10,000 orders daily.

Translated packing-floor constraints into operational requirements and coordinated with account stakeholders and AcrossB developers. Following a customer-led Workpad SKU-grouping update, addressed remaining information-transfer bottlenecks.

Used AI-assisted development to streamline packing-cover data transfer into Google Sheets and SKU-combination box guidance, with operators verifying shipment information before releasing batches to packing.
Refined screen clicks into a keyboard shortcut mapped to a programmable Logitech mouse button; addressed Korean/English information-retrieval inconsistencies with AI assistance.

Contributed to broader documentation and label-printing improvements that reduced daily work from approximately 180-200 to 150 minutes, an estimated 30-50 minutes saved based on operational experience.
Created a separate AI-assisted Gmail, Google Sheets and Apps Script workflow for daily operational summaries; developed a scanner-assisted returns intake workflow with item review before submission.

roles.title: QA Engineer
bullets: Supported Eternights development and PlayStation release QA through gameplay, functional, regression, localization, and release-focused testing.
Authored reproducible defect reports, clarified expected behavior with developers, and verified fixes through targeted regression checks.
Shortened a recurring regression workflow from approximately 8 hours to 4 by using developer-provided save states and checkpoints to reach targeted test scenarios.
Used Unity Test Framework features within the existing development environment for UI-focused validation alongside manual testing.

roles.title: Database Manager
bullets: Analyzed recurring Coupang order preparation and implemented Python/openpyxl automation for field mapping, normalization, validation, and upload-ready shipping data.
Reduced daily order preparation from approximately 3 hours to 30 minutes based on operational observation, with exception review and final upload retained as manual controls.

Validated customs and contact fields, normalized postal and product data, handled options and bundle quantities, and separated incomplete or suspicious records for review. Helped strengthen pre-shipment address and customs-document checks.

roles.title: Owner - Operations & Systems (Part-time)
bullets: Co-own and help operate a Shopify home and tableware business, managing storefront systems, shipping-label workflows, fulfillment support, returns, and business administration with a partner.
Configure and troubleshoot domain, storefront, and shipping settings; maintain transaction and expense records for CPA review.
Completed trademark registration using AI-assisted research; support local consignment and customer-pickup partnerships with CLAEDO and Baking Room.

projects.name: AcrossB Flow QR Helper
projects.text: Defined batch-identification requirements and human controls with AI-assisted development. The helper validates and selects work rows; operators reconcile quantities and complete work.

projects.name: Remembering Young Hoon
projects.text: Led requirements, bilingual submission-review workflows, administrative access decisions, AWS setup, validation, and deployment using AI-assisted development.

skills: Operational systems: Extensiv WMS, Workpad OMS, Excel, Google Sheets, Shopify; ECOUNT ERP (basic).
Automation and QA: Python/openpyxl; AI-assisted JavaScript and Google Apps Script; browser DOM workflows; manual, regression and localization testing; Unity Test Framework use.
Project experience: Git/GitHub, HTML/CSS, React and Node.js; AWS configuration and deployment with AI-assisted development; Selenium project work. SQL: basic knowledge.
education: B.S. in Computer Science, California State University, Northridge
certifications: ISTQB Certified Tester - Foundation Level; ISTQB Agile Tester; Microsoft Office Specialist
